commands: python scripts/dev/desk.py post "fabio v3 L3 IS-only rerun, managed Model B" --need "python -m MyTradingSys.backtest.layers.fabio.run_v3_l3 --is-only --out F:/MTS/data/fabio_v3_bt_isonly; copy is_only.json IS net R per model A-D + Model B fill count into FABIO_V3_L3_NOT_MEASURED.md" --done-when "NOT_MEASURED.md has measured IS net R, no OOS number" --target JIS-NB
done_when: FABIO_V3_L3_NOT_MEASURED.md replaces the NOT MEASURED counts with measured IS net R per model A-D and the Model B fill count; no OOS figure present.
goal: FABIO_V3_L3_NOT_MEASURED.md says Model B IN_TRADE fills scored 0 R (42 IS, 4 OOS fills) and the IS rerun is pending on a host with F:/MTS/data. Rerun IS only after the --is-only flag lands, report net R per model and window, replace the NOT MEASURED counts. DESK task, not a builder.
note: REVIEWED:2026-11-01 ACCEPT. Waits for fabio-v3-l3-is-only-flag to be done (depends_on); then check promotes it.
scope_out: OOS windows (never read), HOLDOUT, run_v3_l3.py code, the registered F:/MTS/data/fabio_v3_bt/selection.json (use a new --out)
steps: Wait for fabio-v3-l3-is-only-flag to be done, then post the desk task from commands (JIS-NB lane; run-and-report is never a builder).

Desk host runs the command, copies the IS numbers (mean net R at 2 bps per model, n windows, Model B fill count) into FABIO_V3_L3_NOT_MEASURED.md, labels them IS and DEV-only, ships. Verify: content commit sha; git cherry origin/fast-track <sha> empty; git ls-tree -r origin/fast-track --name-only lists the delivered files.
